verdict.rationale: Veriff docs mention a 'No-code identity verification solution' and a Customer Portal for manual review, implying some no-engineering path, but there is no concrete evidence of a shareable verification link or QR code generation feature for one-off use cases — the bulk of the documentation focuses on API/SDK integration requiring engineering setup. missing for 10: explicit link/QR code generation feature, portal workflow for creating and sending one-off verification links, confirmation this requires no API integration.
